title: 较长对话或独白　听力第二节 · 练习
goal: 听懂较长对话和独白的主旨、细节与原因。

points.label: 概括谈话或独白的主要内容
根据原因和限制解释决定

sources.title: 2024 年高考综合改革适应性测试 英语（新课标卷）试卷（教育部教育考试院）

lines.text: Hi, Nina. Have you decided what our class should do for the community day? We need to give the teacher a plan by Friday.
I've been thinking about the riverside path. There's a lot of litter there after weekends, and younger children use the path to get to the park.
Cleaning it sounds useful. I originally wanted to plant trees, but the council says we need special permission to dig there.
Then let's collect litter instead. My uncle can lend us gloves and bags, so we won't need to buy those. We should still ask the council where to leave the full bags.
I'll make that call tomorrow. Can you write a notice for our classmates? We should meet at the school gate at nine and walk down together.
Sure. I'll also ask everyone to wear strong shoes. If it rains heavily, we can move the work to the following Saturday.

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly planning?
options: A class visit to a park.
items.why: 两人商量组织同学清理河边步道上的垃圾。

items.stem: What will the first speaker do?
items.why: 第一人说明天打电话给议会，通知由另一人写。

items.stem: Why do they decide against planting trees?
options: They cannot find a place to meet.
items.why: 议会说在那里挖土需要特别许可。

lines.text: Good morning, visitors. Welcome to the town museum's Saturday workshop. Today we'll learn how people made paper by hand. First, please leave your coats on the hooks near the entrance. The tables in the main hall are already set up with bowls, screens and pieces of old paper. At ten, our guide will show you each step, and after that you can make a sheet of your own. We had planned to dry the sheets outdoors, but the forecast says rain is likely, so we will use the warm room upstairs instead. Your paper will need several hours to dry. You may collect it from the front desk tomorrow afternoon, or leave your address and we can post it to you. Children should work with an adult, because the bowls of water can be difficult to carry. If you have any questions, please ask a member of staff wearing a blue badge.

items.stem: What is the announcement mainly about?
items.why: 通知介绍博物馆手工造纸活动的安排。
由于可能下雨，纸张改在楼上的暖室晾干。

items.stem: Why should children work with an adult?
options: The bowls of water may be hard to carry.
They must write a postal address.
items.why: 通知说明装水的盆可能难以搬动。

lines.text: Hello, Maya. Have you thought about our school exhibition? The history teacher wants us to display something made by students.
Yes. I first thought of old maps, but we don't have permission to borrow the originals. What about making models of buildings in our town?
That would work. We can use cardboard from the art room. I could make the old railway station, and you could build the library.
I'd like to make the library, but I need to measure it first. Can you take photographs of the station this afternoon?
Certainly. I'll also ask the art teacher for paint. We should finish the models by Thursday so that we have Friday to arrange them.
I'll write a short description for each model after we finish. Visitors can read about how the buildings were used in the past.

options: A visit to an art room.
items.why: 两人计划制作本地建筑模型供学校展览。

items.stem: What will the first speaker photograph?
items.why: 第一人答应给火车站拍照，另一人负责图书馆模型。

items.stem: Why do the speakers not display old maps?
items.why: 他们没有获准借用原始地图。

lines.text: Hello, everyone. Here is some information about Saturday's community garden visit. We will meet at the school gate at nine and take the bus together. Please bring a bottle of water and wear shoes suitable for walking on wet ground. At the garden, a volunteer will show us how rainwater is collected for the plants. After that, we will help prepare a small bed for vegetables. We had hoped to pick fruit as well, but the fruit is not ready yet. Instead, the gardeners will show us the seeds they have saved from last year. Lunch will be in the covered area beside the garden, so please bring your own food. We expect to return to school at two. If you cannot attend, tell your class teacher by Thursday so that another student can use your place. Thank you, and I hope you enjoy the visit.

items.stem: What is the announcement mainly about?
options: A visit to a community garden.
items.why: 通知说明周六参观社区花园的集合、活动和返回安排。

items.stem: Where will the group have lunch?
options: In a covered area beside the garden.
items.why: 通知说午饭在花园旁有遮盖的地方吃。

items.stem: Why will the group not pick fruit?
options: There is no bus to the garden.
items.why: 水果还没有成熟，所以改为看保存的种子。
